title: Core: AS2 Array.prototype advanced methods
description: Verify AS2 advanced Array methods compile: a.filter(fn) (AS2 may not have filter — test what exists), a.map(fn), a.forEach(fn), a.every(fn), a.some(fn), a.reduce(fn, init). Also Array.isArray(x). If these don't exist in AS2 (they're AS3 features), verify they fail gracefully and document. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/arrayadvanced.test.ts.
